coordinate_note: Board-local coordinates use the 104 x 62 mm B3 core envelope; enclosure-external coordinates are screening values assuming the DSI506 rear PCB is centered in the 124 x 80 mm inner cavity of the 128 x 84 mm enclosure candidate.

primary_long_io_wall.placement_rule: Keep USB pair together left of the RCA pair when viewing the approved top wall from the rear/mainboard side. Exact connector center spacing is set from final footprints and plug/cutout courtyards.

power_wall.placement_rule: Use a local left I/O wing or controlled connector overhang. Do not expand the entire board to the left display corner-post line.

upper_recovery_zone.rule: Keep both actuator/tool-hole centers above the FFC corridor and outside the upper mounting-hole screw-head keepout.

lower_media_zone.rule: Orient the card entry toward the right wall; final socket/card/ejection envelope must remain below the FFC corridor and clear the lower-right mounting screw.

clear_long_wall.rule: Do not consume this wall during Rev-A placement unless another gate proves the approved three-wall topology infeasible.

display_facing: host DSI receptacle is the only planned component exception
avoid exposed test pads or tall solder features in display obstruction areas
rear_outward: J7/SW1/SW2 may occupy rear-side right wing/edge
connector screw heads and rear-cover clearance must remain inside the 16.4 mm gross cavity screen

still_open: exact host DSI connector center/orientation and 60 mm FFC U-bend path
exact panel cutout centers and dimensions
mounting screw-head/washer and NPTH final diameter
